node-postgres for the runtime's Postgres steps: the npm tarballs of pg 8.21.0 and the dependencies it loads, files kept unmodified under node_modules/ (tests, benchmarks, TypeScript sources, ESM wrappers and READMEs left out).
The versions n8n 2.47.7 ships (its Postgres node runs pg-promise 11.9.1 on pg 8.21.0), checked equal file for file to the copies in the n8nio/n8n:2.47.7 image.
Licences: pg, pg-pool, pg-protocol, pg-connection-string, pg-types, pgpass, postgres-array, postgres-bytea, postgres-date, postgres-interval, xtend: MIT; pg-int8, split2: ISC. Licence files beside each package where its tarball has one; pg-types and pgpass ship none, their MIT notice is in LICENSES.txt.
Loaded only when a Postgres step runs (runtime/src/pgclient.mjs, from the task driver or a bench host, through node:module createRequire); copied into a migrated folder only when its definition has one.
